title: Applied Materials reports Q3 revenue up 25% YoY to $9.12B, vs. $8.99B est., net income up 43% to $2.54B, and forecasts Q4 revenue above estimates (Elias Schisgall/Wall Street Journal)
summary:
Elias Schisgall / Wall Street Journal:
Applied Materials reports Q3 revenue up 25% YoY to $9.12B, vs. $8.99B est., net income up 43% to $2.54B, and forecasts Q4 revenue above estimates  —  The company is looking to ramp up its manufacturing capacity to meet continued semiconductor solutions demand

title: Charter receives final state approval to buy Cox for $21.9B after making concessions to California regulators, including low-cost internet for some households (Patience Haggin/Wall Street Journal)
summary:
Patience Haggin / Wall Street Journal:
Charter receives final state approval to buy Cox for $21.9B after making concessions to California regulators, including low-cost internet for some households  —  Cable and broadband providers receive regulatory clearance from California after agreeing to some concessions on affordability
